hens_rule_text: Up to 8 domestic fowl allowed on any residential lot with no permit; lots over 10,000 sq ft may keep one additional bird for each extra 1,000 sq ft of lot area.
permit_notes: No permit is required to keep the allowed number of hens.
setback_notes: Coop must be at least 10 ft from property lines; no separate distance from neighboring dwellings was found.
coop_rules: Coop must be properly constructed and kept in a sanitary condition; general nuisance rules apply.
zoning_notes: Rules are in Seattle Municipal Code Sec. 23.42.052, Keeping of animals, and apply citywide.
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.

sources.name: HenRules, Backyard Chicken Laws in Washington
Seattle Homestead, Urban Chicken Laws in Washington

research_notes: SMC 23.42.052 was not opened directly; the 8-hen cap, no-permit status, 10 ft setback and the 1,000 sq ft expansion rule all come from secondary summaries, not the code text itself, though the sources agree with each other.
